style.name: Tessera & Lime
style.line: broken umber contours and hand-painted tessera joins
style.shading: flat fresco planes with sparse tile shadows
style.style_block: STYLE: A hand-drawn digital fusion of Roman fresco and mosaic. Broken umber contours surround flat chalk-lime and terracotta forms; small irregular painted tessera shapes cluster at architectural edges while open ground remains broad matte pigment. Mineral blue and pale turquoise carry water, vermilion carries hostile fire, dull ochre carries stone and bronze. Shading is flattened fresco colour planes with rubbed plaster gaps, never realistic volume; ornament has civic gravity but the mood is sun-bleached captivity. The mosaic is a drawing language inside the scene, not a photograph of a wall or a framed historical artifact.

input.prompt:
EXTREME LONG SHOT, HIGH AERIAL VIEW. Landscape arena floor fills the entire 16:9 image. The camera is 55 degrees above the ground. Tiny overhead people with the tops of their heads visible, each whole person 4% of image height (29 pixels at 720p). The distant people look like tiny specks on a huge map: no faces or anatomy details. Vast empty floor separates every person. No large person, no foreground person. A huge training court with four low square plinths staggered near the outer thirds, leaving a very broad clear centre and bypass lanes. Floor extends beyond the frame. One tiny blue mage near centre and four tiny ochre/red enemies spaced widely, with clear escape paths between. A little cyan open crescent immediately in front of the blue mage, facing one incoming red projectile; the back of the mage is open. Two hollow red floor warning circles twice the height of a person. One thin blue bolt. The setting and immense ground area dominate; people are miniature accents.

Use case: stylized-concept. Original Roman-era elemental-mage arena, Tessera & Lime palette: chalk sand, terracotta, mineral blue, umber contour. Hand-painted digital overhead map with small edge tesserae and matte pigment. Do not depict an ancient wall mural: depict a playable arena seen from high above. No text, UI, letters, logos or photorealism.
